Value: Film specimen (ASTM D882); not a printed or moulded bar
Not published (density specimen form not explicitly established)

Meaning: A bar the document does not say in so many words was printed, whose document implies it all the same: its own row or its table labels a print orientation, a heading names the printed part, print settings are given for the test specimens, or a statement about how the document's test specimens were made speaks for it, and nothing ties it to moulding or to the base resin (the owner's ruling of 2026-10-20, D172). The Notes quote what implies it, with its page. It decides as a printed bar does.

A bar printed at a print setting its sheet prints beside the one the product is meant to be printed at, and not that one: colorFabb's lightweight PETs foam at 260 °C and are printed unfoamed at 210 °C for a second column (D95). Recorded and shown; never a product value, a bound or an estimate observation.

A bar its sheet says was printed below 100 % infill (3DJake's sheets print 'Infill: 20 %'; the row's print parameters say how much): the strength and stiffness of a part filled that far, not of the material as a solid part. Recorded and shown with that label; never a product value, a bound or an estimate observation (D130).
